rows.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN death_city LIKE '%paris%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN death_city LIKE '%york%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN death_city LIKE '%london%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 'awarded' ELSE 'unawarded' END AS award_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE death_city <> '' GROUP BY field_family, award_status
SELECT art_movement, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE art_movement <> '' GROUP BY art_movement
SELECT CASE WHEN object <> '' THEN 'known_institution' ELSE 'institution_unknown' END AS institution_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art GROUP BY institution_status

SELECT marriage, CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 'taught' ELSE 'did_not_teach' END AS teaching_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE marriage <> '' AND NOT teaching IS NULL GROUP BY marriage, teaching_status

SELECT composition, CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 'taught' ELSE 'did_not_teach' END AS teaching_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE composition IN ('Balanced', 'Asymmetrical', 'Centralized', 'Dynamic', 'Symmetrical', 'Central Focus') AND NOT teaching IS NULL GROUP BY composition, teaching_status

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE object IN ('Geometric Shapes', 'Human Figure') AND field <> '' GROUP BY field_family
SELECT genre, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE genre <> '' GROUP BY genre

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, CASE WHEN zodiac IN ('Aries', 'Taurus', 'Pisces', 'Gemini', 'Leo', 'Aquarius', 'Sagittarius') THEN zodiac WHEN zodiac <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS color_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE field <> '' AND zodiac <> '' GROUP BY field_family, color_family
SELECT zodiac, century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE zodiac IN ('Aries', 'Taurus', 'Pisces', 'Gemini', 'Leo') AND century <> '' GROUP BY zodiac, century
SELECT composition, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE composition <> '' GROUP BY composition
SELECT composition, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE teaching = 1 AND awards = 0 AND composition <> '' GROUP BY composition HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

SELECT composition, CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 'awarded' ELSE 'unawarded' END AS award_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE composition IN ('Balanced', 'Asymmetrical', 'Centralized', 'Dynamic', 'Symmetrical', 'Central Focus') GROUP BY composition, award_status
SELECT marriage, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE marriage <> '' GROUP BY marriage HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE genre IN ('Abstract', 'Landscape', 'Portrait', 'Figurative', 'Portrait||Landscape', 'Landscape||Portrait', 'Surrealism', 'Avant-garde') AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY genre

SELECT CASE WHEN tone IN ('Neutral', 'Bright', 'Dark', 'Warm') THEN tone WHEN tone <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS tone_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE image_genre = 'Portrait' AND object IN ('Geometric Shapes', 'Human Figure', 'Human Figures', 'Shapes') GROUP BY tone_family
SELECT death_city, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards FROM art WHERE death_city <> '' GROUP BY death_city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15
SELECT century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE name LIKE '%shahn%' AND century <> '' GROUP BY century
SELECT genre, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM art WHERE awards >= 1 AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 AND genre <> '' GROUP BY genre

SELECT CASE WHEN art_movement IN ('Surrealism', 'Abstract Expressionism', 'Realism', 'Pop Art', 'Impressionism', 'Contemporary', 'Abstract') THEN art_movement WHEN art_movement <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS color_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE art_movement <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY color_family HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
SELECT zodiac, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE zodiac <> '' GROUP BY zodiac HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15

SELECT composition, CASE WHEN nationality = 'American' THEN 'American' WHEN nationality <> '' THEN 'non_American' END AS nationality_group, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE composition <> '' AND nationality <> '' GROUP BY composition, nationality_group
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE death_country <> '' AND death_country <> birth_country AND genre <> '' GROUP BY genre
SELECT zodiac, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM art WHERE zodiac <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY zodiac

SELECT CASE WHEN birth_city IN ('Paris', 'London', 'New York City', 'New York') THEN birth_city WHEN birth_city <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS tone_family, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM art WHERE image_genre IN ('Portrait', 'Landscape', 'Still Life', 'Abstract') AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY tone_family

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE birth_city IN ('Paris', 'London', 'New York City', 'New York', 'Philadelphia') AND field <> '' GROUP BY field_family

SELECT century, CASE WHEN art_movement <> '' THEN 'known_institution' ELSE 'institution_unknown' END AS institution_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE century <> '' GROUP BY century, institution_status

SELECT CASE WHEN art_movement IN ('Surrealism', 'Abstract Expressionism', 'Realism') THEN art_movement ELSE 'Other' END AS continent_group, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards, MAX(awards) AS max_awards, SUM(CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_count FROM art WHERE art_movement <> '' GROUP BY continent_group
SELECT art_movement, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE art_movement <> '' GROUP BY art_movement HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

SELECT CASE WHEN zodiac IN ('Aries', 'Taurus', 'Pisces', 'Gemini') THEN zodiac WHEN zodiac <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS tone_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE zodiac <> '' GROUP BY tone_family

SELECT CASE WHEN object LIKE '%geometric%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN object LIKE '%human%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN object LIKE '%figures%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_count FROM art WHERE object <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY field_family

SELECT image_genre, CASE WHEN genre IN ('Abstract', 'Landscape', 'Portrait', 'Figurative') THEN genre ELSE 'Other' END AS color_group, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE image_genre IN ('Portrait', 'Landscape', 'Still Life', 'Abstract') AND genre <> '' GROUP BY image_genre, color_group

SELECT CASE WHEN zodiac IN ('Aries', 'Taurus') THEN zodiac ELSE 'Other' END AS continent_group, CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 'awarded' ELSE 'unawarded' END AS award_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE zodiac <> '' GROUP BY continent_group, award_status
SELECT century, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards FROM art WHERE zodiac <> '' AND century <> '' GROUP BY century

SELECT CASE WHEN death_city LIKE '%paris%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN death_city LIKE '%york%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN death_city LIKE '%london%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, CASE WHEN age < 60 THEN 'under_60' ELSE '60_or_older' END AS age_band, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE death_city <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY field_family, age_band

SELECT composition, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS awarded_count FROM art WHERE composition <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY composition HAVING COUNT(*) >= 12
SELECT art_movement, MIN(age) AS youngest FROM art WHERE art_movement <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY art_movement

SELECT CASE WHEN awards = 0 THEN 'no_awards' WHEN awards = 1 THEN 'one_award' ELSE 'multiple_awards' END AS award_band, teaching, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, death_city FROM art WHERE NOT teaching IS NULL AND NOT awards IS NULL GROUP BY award_band, teaching, death_city

SELECT CASE WHEN tone IN ('Neutral', 'Bright', 'Dark', 'Warm') THEN tone WHEN tone <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS tone_family, zodiac, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE tone <> '' AND zodiac IN ('Aries', 'Taurus', 'Pisces', 'Gemini') GROUP BY tone_family, zodiac
SELECT zodiac, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, MIN(age) AS youngest, MAX(age) AS oldest, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards FROM art WHERE zodiac <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY zodiac

SELECT CASE WHEN object LIKE '%geometric%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN object LIKE '%human%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN object LIKE '%figures%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE object <> '' GROUP BY field_family
SELECT birth_city, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE awards >= 1 AND birth_city <> '' GROUP BY birth_city

SELECT teaching, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE (NOT teaching IS NULL AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105) AND genre = 'Abstract' GROUP BY teaching

SELECT death_city, century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE death_city IN ('Paris', 'New York', 'London', 'New York City', 'Mexico City', 'Philadelphia') AND century <> '' GROUP BY death_city, century

SELECT CASE WHEN death_country <> '' AND death_country <> name THEN 'died_abroad' WHEN death_country <> '' THEN 'died_in_birth_country' ELSE 'death_country_unknown' END AS death_place, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_count FROM art WHERE age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY death_place

SELECT genre, CASE WHEN age < 50 THEN 'under_50' WHEN age < 75 THEN '50_to_74' ELSE '75_or_older' END AS age_band, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE genre <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY genre, age_band

SELECT birth_continent, CASE WHEN genre IN ('Abstract', 'Landscape', 'Portrait', 'Figurative') THEN genre WHEN genre <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS tone_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE birth_continent <> '' AND genre <> '' GROUP BY birth_continent, tone_family
SELECT century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE genre IN ('Abstract', 'Landscape', 'Portrait', 'Figurative') AND age BETWEEN 40 AND 90 AND century <> '' GROUP BY century

SELECT CASE WHEN composition IN ('Balanced', 'Asymmetrical', 'Centralized', 'Dynamic', 'Symmetrical', 'Central Focus', 'Geometric') THEN composition WHEN composition <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS color_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE composition <> '' GROUP BY color_family

SELECT CASE WHEN death_city LIKE '%paris%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN death_city LIKE '%york%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN death_city LIKE '%london%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE death_city <> '' AND century <> '' GROUP BY field_family, century

SELECT art_movement, CASE WHEN death_country <> '' AND death_country <> birth_country THEN 'died_abroad' WHEN death_country <> '' THEN 'died_in_birth_country' ELSE 'death_country_unknown' END AS death_place, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE art_movement <> '' GROUP BY art_movement, death_place
SELECT teaching, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, genre FROM art WHERE age >= 80 AND age <= 105 AND NOT teaching IS NULL GROUP BY teaching, genre
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(awards) AS total_awards FROM art WHERE genre <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY genre HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
SELECT birth_city, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE birth_city <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY birth_city
SELECT marriage, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE teaching = 1 AND marriage <> '' GROUP BY marriage

SELECT marriage, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, SUM(CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS awarded_count, SUM(CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM art WHERE marriage <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY marriage

SELECT marriage, CASE WHEN tone IN ('Neutral', 'Bright', 'Dark') THEN tone ELSE 'Other' END AS tone_group, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE marriage IN ('Married', 'Unmarried', 'Remarried', 'Divorced', 'Widowed') AND tone <> '' GROUP BY marriage, tone_group
SELECT art_movement, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE awards >= 2 AND art_movement <> '' GROUP BY art_movement HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
SELECT composition, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE composition <> '' GROUP BY composition HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

SELECT object, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, MIN(age) AS youngest, MAX(age) AS oldest, SUM(awards) AS total_awards FROM art WHERE object IN ('Geometric Shapes', 'Human Figure', 'Human Figures', 'Shapes', 'Geometric Forms') AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY object

SELECT CASE WHEN composition IN ('Balanced', 'Asymmetrical', 'Centralized', 'Dynamic') THEN composition WHEN composition <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS tone_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards FROM art WHERE composition <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY tone_family

SELECT CASE WHEN death_date LIKE '%1905/5/13%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN death_date LIKE '%1905/6/3%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN death_date LIKE '%1905/7/7%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards FROM art WHERE death_date <> '' AND century <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY field_family, century HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
SELECT object, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE object <> '' GROUP BY object HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
SELECT object, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE tone IN ('Bright', 'Dark') AND object <> '' GROUP BY object HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT birth_continent, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN birth_city <> '' AND birth_city <> birth_country THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS died_abroad_count, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE birth_continent <> '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY birth_continent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
